subject: P-value and CI for pairwise modularity.test

messages.author: 96a78639336ed702
messages.subject: P-value and CI for pairwise modularity.test
parts:
User manual for modularity.test included an example comparing two groups of landmarks. I modified the code there into 3 landmark sets:

> data(pupfish)
> Y.gpa<-gpagen(pupfish$coords, print.progress = FALSE) #GPA-alignment
> #landmarks on the body and operculum
> land.gps<-rep('a',56); land.gps[39:48]<-'b'; land.gps[49:56]<-'c'
> 
> MT <- modularity.test(Y.gpa$coords,land.gps,CI=T,iter=99)
> MT

With MT$CR.mat, pairwise CR could be obtained. However, it seems no P-value and CI can be extracted. MT only provides P-value and CI for the overall CR measure rather than pairwise measures. How to derive P-value and CI for pairwise CR value?

Best regards,
Patrick
